svg.title: Where the serving work runs, before and after
svg.desc: Today ATOM's Python API processes render, tokenize, detokenize, parse and write SSE; with gRPC atomesh does that work in Rust, and ATOM keeps admission, prefix hashes and the engine.
svg.text: Where the serving work runs, per request
moves from ATOM's Python API process into atomesh (Rust)
pair P and D, relay kv params
P side: 140 ms CPU per request
moves into atomesh, once per request
parse; route; pair P and D
P side: 7.4 ms CPU per request
CPU per request: the P instances' API processes, zero-forward fake engines in the 6P16D layout, AgentX at C1228, two runs per door.
